sections.text: The honest part about the word 'whitening'

sections.content: No cream changes the colour you were born with. Not this one, not the imported ones at ten times the price.

What these products do is brighten and even out tone. They reduce the look of dark patches, post-acne marks, and the dullness that comes from sun exposure and not enough sleep. That is a real result and it is worth paying for. It is not a different skin colour, and any before-and-after photo that suggests otherwise was lit differently in the second frame.

This matters because the disappointment is expensive. People buy a Rs. 800 cream expecting a different complexion, use it for two weeks, and conclude skincare doesn't work. The cream was fine. The expectation was sold to them.
Glutathione, the active named on most of these labels, is an antioxidant. It is in the serum and the creams. It is not a bleach, and anyone who tells you it is has a bottle to sell you.

sections.text: Don't buy Gluta White from us if…

sections.content: You want to be two shades lighter in a month. It won't happen, and you will blame the product. Save the Rs. 826.

You're not going to use sunblock. This is the important one. Every dark patch these creams are trying to fade gets darker again with sun exposure. Buying the night cream but skipping the Rs. 683 sunblock is spending money to walk backwards — the sunblock is the cheaper half of the routine and it does more work.

You have sensitive skin or an active breakout. Start with the face wash alone for a week before adding a cream on top. Two new products at once tells you nothing except that one of them disagreed with you.
Face wash, day and night cream, and sunblock: Rs. 767 + Rs. 826 + Rs. 683 = **Rs. 2,276**. That is roughly what one imported serum costs on its own.
If you want to spend less, buy the sunblock and one cream and skip the rest. Rs. 1,509 covers the two things that do the most work.

sections.text: Hands and feet are the neglected part

sections.content: The hand and foot cream at Rs. 801 is the product people come back for, and it is the one most people skip on the first order. Knuckles and heels darken from friction and sun, not from anything a face wash will fix. It's 100ml, which lasts longer than the face products because you're not using it twice a day on a small surface.

items.q: What is the price of Gluta White in Pakistan?
items.a: At BazaarNow, Gluta White products run from Rs. 683 for the SPF 60 sunblock to Rs. 826 for the day and night cream, as of November 2026. All seven products are under Rs. 830.

items.q: Does Gluta White actually whiten skin?
items.a: It brightens and evens tone, which reduces the look of dark patches and post-acne marks. It does not change your natural skin colour. No cream does, regardless of price or brand.

items.q: How long before I see a difference?
items.a: Six to eight weeks for tone and dark patches, with daily sunblock. Two weeks is not enough to judge any brightening product, and most disappointment comes from stopping too early.

items.q: Which Gluta White product should I buy first?
items.a: The sunblock at Rs. 683. It prevents new dark patches, which is the part most people skip and the part that makes everything else look like it isn't working.

items.q: Can I use Gluta White with other skincare?
items.a: Yes, but introduce one product at a time. Starting a face wash, a serum and a night cream in the same week makes it impossible to tell what suited you if something goes wrong.

items.q: Do you deliver Gluta White across Pakistan?
items.a: Yes, free delivery to over 100 cities. Most orders arrive in 2 to 4 working days, and cash on delivery is available on every order.

items.q: Is Gluta White suitable for oily skin?
items.a: The deep cleansing face wash at Rs. 826 is the better choice for oily skin. The heavier night creams suit dry skin better. If you are unsure, start with the wash only.

sections.content: Buy the sunblock, use it every morning, and give whatever cream you pick two months before you decide it failed. If you were hoping a Rs. 800 tub would change the colour you were born with, we'd rather you kept the Rs. 800 — and we suspect your mirror would too.
